author: phase23-agent
scope: Matched shadow-fold confirmation of the native raw8 member, activated ONLY if the primary protocol (configs/phase23/raw8_kaggle_prereg.json) nominates at least one candidate. Frozen before any shadow data exists. No submission is authorized by this protocol.

amendment.reason: The phase-17 shadow confirmation already produced CERTIFIED shadow arms for the predeclared shadow folds 2 and 3: the route2 member set (n_estimators=2, full context, same checkpoint/seeds, shadow FIT rows) with its composed portfolio, and the auxiliary10 member-mean logits. Reusing them removes the route-arm GPU rerun and the aux10 CPU refits from this protocol and makes the comparison exactly matched (same FIT rows, same fold geometry, same aggregation). The fold set {2,3} was predeclared by phase 17 before any of its results existed; no raw8 shadow data exists at amendment time.
changes: arm_R: rerun -> reuse certified artifacts/phase17_shadow_B1/f{2,3} + artifacts/phase17_shadow_aux10
composition formula: fixed to the reconstructed certified formula (max deviation 1.8e-7 on both folds)

port validity gate: route-repro kernel run replaced by an in-evaluator reuse-reconstruction gate (the port's environment equivalence is separately certified by the Kaggle probe and the local CPU dry-run)

activation: primary numerical_gate_pass == true for at least one candidate; otherwise this protocol is void and recorded as NOT_ACTIVATED.
question: Is the primary marginal of replacing the certified route member with our native raw8 member inside the certified 50/50 logit composition (with the auxiliary10 arm) reproducible on an independent fold geometry (seed 777001), with every arm evaluated on shadow FIT/apply rows only?
why_not_a_standalone_ab: The member-level A/B (raw8 vs route2 standalone) is NOT the right endpoint: the certified route2 standalone OOF (0.9615159787) is ~3.7e-4 ABOVE the external raw8 standalone (0.9611450968 on our labels), while raw8 still adds +2.99e-5 pooled at w=0.10 inside the composition (external diagnostic). The claimed mechanism is complementarity inside the composition, so the confirmatory endpoint is the portfolio comparison with a common auxiliary arm.

folds.row_alignment: apply rows = np.flatnonzero(shadow_folds == f); verified identical to the certified artifacts' apply_ids and aux member id files for both folds

arm_W.member: native raw8 (our protocol): raw 21-column geometry, n_estimators=8, full context (559,708 shadow FIT rows), official aggregation

arm_R.member: certified route2 control: route geometry (21 raw + Flight Distance coarse10; categorical [13,14,15,16,18,21]), n_estimators=2, full context, same checkpoint/seeds, shadow FIT rows
arm_R.note: portfolio_sha256 values are the first 16 hex chars of arr_sha256(portfolio.npy); the evaluator re-verifies them in full

arm_A.member: certified auxiliary10 member-mean logits on the same shadow folds

composition.member_probability_mean: mean over members of softmax(member raw logits) (official aggregation; verified against the certified route portfolio at max|delta| = 1.8e-7 on both folds)
composition.candidate_W_portfolio: same formula with arm W's official aggregate in place of arm R's
composition.reuse_validity_gate: the evaluator must re-derive the certified route portfolio from arm R's raw member logits + arm A and match portfolio.npy within 2e-6 on BOTH folds; on failure the protocol reports OUTCOME_INVALID and computes no gate

statistics.endpoint_E1_member_ab: pooled paired AUC delta of arm_W vs arm_R over the two shadow folds (diagnostic, recorded, not gating)
statistics.endpoint_E2_portfolio: pooled paired AUC delta of portfolio_W vs portfolio_R over the two shadow folds (279,854 rows), row-level paired SE from the placement covariance, plus the two per-fold AUC deltas
statistics.confirmatory_rule: E2 pooled delta >= +1.0e-5 AND >= 2.5 x pooled paired row-level SE AND both per-fold deltas > 0
statistics.secondary_report: the fixed-weight analogue expit((1-w*)*logit(R)+w* *logit(W)) with w* the primary-passing weight is reported as context only and never gates

decision.confirmed: record SHADOW_CONFIRMED in the ledger; the member becomes eligible for a submission decision under PATH A/B (separate committed decision)
decision.not_confirmed: record SHADOW_NOT_CONFIRMED; the primary marginal is classified as fold-specific and no submission may rest on it

known_deviations: Two shadow folds (2 and 3) rather than five; SE is pooled row-level plus the two per-fold deltas, mirroring the phase-17 shadow confirmation scope.

The shadow arms run on Kaggle T4 (fp16 autocast) while the certified route/aux shadow arms were produced locally (RTX 5070 Ti); the reuse validity gate and the Kaggle probe bound this risk. The raw8 arm itself is new on both geometries, so no bitwise cross-platform obligation attaches to it.
The certified route shadow arm used the same checkpoint otherwise, but was produced before this protocol existed; its member logits are reused unmodified and hash-checked.
stop_rules: Never run without the activation condition being met.
Never use the shadow folds for tuning or selection of any kind.
Never bypass the local GPU hardware stop; Kaggle free quota only.
Any submission requires a separate committed SUBMISSION_DECISION under PATH A/B and an OOF gain threshold the primary evidence alone may not meet.
